finding.title: Add Locale('he') RTL coverage for GoalSetupForm/GoalSetupScreen and StudyDaysReadOnly
finding.why: _buildGoalFormHarness/_buildGoalScreenHarness already accept a `locale` parameter, but of the ~15 tests across groups D-I (goal-type switching, deadline mode, pace mode with Amudim/Dafim/Perakim/Pesukim unit-picker pills, submission, screen wrapper) not one passes Locale('he') — the single Hebrew test in this 1407-line file (line 401) covers only the unrelated Tutor PIN dialog. Likewise StudyDaysReadOnly (tests 10-14) has no RTL variant even though its sibling StudyDaysEditable does (test #9). TQ-3 exists precisely because 'RTL-only layout and overflow bugs—which this app ships fixes for every audit wave—are invisible to LTR-only tests', and GoalSetupForm's slider + segmented unit-picker pills are exactly the kind of layout most prone to RTL overflow.
finding.recommendation: Add at least one Locale('he') smoke test per screen (mirroring the existing StudyDaysEditable/ContentHierarchyScreen/TutorPinVerificationDialog pattern already in this batch) asserting no overflow/crash for GoalSetupForm (pace mode with a unit picker) and for StudyDaysReadOnly.
acceptance_criteria: at least one testWidgets case per screen pumps with locale: const Locale('he') and asserts find.byType(Scaffold) (or equivalent) renders without a FlutterError/overflow

finding.title: Deduplicate the MockBookmarkRepository class defined identically in two test files

evidence.quote: class MockBookmarkRepository extends Mock implements BookmarkRepository {}
class MockBookmarkRepository extends Mock implements BookmarkRepository {}

finding.why: The identical public top-level mock class is redefined verbatim in two files that both exercise BulkPriorCompletionService, instead of living once in test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart per this repo's own documented shared-mocks convention (testing-guide.md). Harmless today since both copies are byte-identical, but the two can silently drift (one updated for a BookmarkRepository interface change, the other missed) with no compiler signal since they're in separate libraries.
finding.recommendation: Move MockBookmarkRepository into test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart and import it from both call sites.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'class MockBookmarkRepository' test/ returns exactly one definition, imported by both former call sites

finding.title: Delete or reactivate the dead tautological placeholders in v15_to_v16_test.dart's skipped group
finding.why: Both assertions are dead literals left after the derived_from_events column was removed: line 68-72 is `expect(true, isFalse, ...)` which will FAIL immediately the instant the group's `skip:` is lifted, and line 111-116 is `expect(true, isTrue, ...)` which passes forever and tests nothing. This repo's own root CLAUDE.md documents the reactivation workflow as "remove the skip: parameter... replace the empty () {} bodies with real assertions" — implying skipped tests should carry empty bodies, exactly the clean pattern used two files over in v18_to_v19_test.dart in this same batch. Worse, two of the four tests in this same skipped group (duplicate-commit dedup, migration-backfill row survival) contain real, still-valid assertions unrelated to the removed field and could be unskipped today, but sit dark under one blanket skip.
finding.recommendation: Delete the two placeholder tests (or rewrite them against whatever invariant superseded derived_from_events), and split the two tests with real assertions out of the skipped group so they run in CI now.
acceptance_criteria: grep for `expect(true, isFalse` / `expect(true, isTrue` with a `// placeholder` marker in test/ returns zero hits
the duplicate-commit and migration-backfill tests in this file run unskipped in CI

finding.title: Replace DateTime.now() with the DateTimeFactory clock seam in stage_sync_test.dart's track fixture
finding.why: The `_insertTrack` helper calls the real wall clock instead of `DateTimeFactory.nowUtc()` — the established deterministic seam (routes through the swappable `LocalDayClock`) that every sibling file in this same batch uses (v16_to_v17_test.dart, v17_to_v18_test.dart, restore_skip_onboarding_test.dart, etc.). Neither field is currently asserted on so it doesn't flake today, but it's a landmine: the moment an assertion is added against stateChangedAt/activatedAt, or stage-scheduling logic branches on track age, the test becomes wall-clock-dependent and can fail non-deterministically near day/DST boundaries or under a frozen-clock CI harness.
finding.recommendation: Swap both fields to `DateTimeFactory.nowUtc()` (or a fixed `DateTime.utc(...)` literal), matching every other file in this batch.
acceptance_criteria: grep for `DateTime.now()` in test/integration/stage_sync_test.dart returns zero hits

finding.title: Tighten v16_to_v17_test.dart's FK-violation assertion beyond throwsA(anything)
finding.why: The test's stated purpose is "C2: FK enforcement must reject completion with non-existent profileId", but `throwsA(anything)` is satisfied by ANY thrown object — a coincidental exception from unrelated test-setup breakage would make this pass without the FK constraint under test ever being exercised, silently losing the regression coverage it claims to provide. Every later migration-gate test in this same directory that checks a similar constraint (v25_to_v27_test.dart, v27_to_v28_test.dart) uses a typed matcher (`isA<SqliteException>()`/`isA<Exception>()`), so this is a real regression in assertion discipline, not a stylistic choice.
finding.recommendation: Narrow to `throwsA(isA<SqliteException>())` (or the concrete exception type Drift/sqlite3 raises for an FK violation), matching the pattern used elsewhere in this same test directory.
acceptance_criteria: v16_to_v17_test.dart's FK test asserts a specific exception type, not `anything`
